# HEILC — AI & Digital Transformation Agency

> Where Human Intelligence Meets the Future. HEILC builds AI-powered products, enterprise software, and custom machine learning models that prove capability, not just describe it.

## Overview
HEILC is an elite AI & Digital Transformation Agency engineering next-generation artificial intelligence solutions. We specialize in turning complex AI research into battle-tested production software for startups, scaleups, and enterprise organizations.

## Core Capabilities
- **Custom AI Products**: Full-stack artificial intelligence product design, execution, and rapid deployment.
- **Enterprise Generative AI**: Custom LLM fine-tuning, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), and autonomous AI agent workflows.
- **Digital Transformation**: Modernizing legacy enterprise systems into cloud-native, AI-first platforms.
- **Intelligence on Demand**: Scalable AI teams and specialized engineering talent for high-impact initiatives.

## Key Services
- **AI Product Engineering**: Architecture, prototyping, and production deployment of AI applications.
- **Enterprise Software Development**: Scalable, high-performance web applications and API platforms.
- **Custom Machine Learning Models**: Domain-specific model training, optimization, and edge deployment.
- **Strategic AI Consulting**: AI roadmapping, ROI analysis, security auditing, and infrastructure design.

## Target Audiences & Use Cases
- **Startups**: Fast-track MVP to live production product in weeks.
- **Enterprises**: Secure, compliant, scalable AI architecture and workflow automation.
- **Innovators & Founders**: Cutting-edge interactive web experiences, 3D visualization, and automated intelligence.

## Technical Stack
- Next.js / React / TypeScript
- Python / PyTorch / TensorFlow / Anthropic Claude API / OpenAI API / Gemini API
- TailwindCSS / Framer Motion / Cobe 3D / Spline 3D
- Serverless API architecture / Cloud Native Infrastructure
